up: Return the compound ChEMBL ID (chembl_id), compound preferred name (pref_name), exact activity value (standard_value), and standard units (standard_units). Filter for assays with chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1054502'. Only include activity rows where standard_relation = '=' and standard_value IS NOT NULL. Do not apply any LIMIT clause.
sql: SELECT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, a.standard_value, a.standard_units FROM assays ass JOIN activities a ON ass.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1054502' AND a.standard_relation = '=' AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL
